checks.description: Private vulnerability-reporting and supported-release policy are documented.
checks.detail: SECURITY.md contains the reporting channel, acknowledgement target, and latest-release policy.

checks.description: The ASVS 5.0 Level 2 assessment scope is versioned and does not overstate conformance.
checks.detail: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 source blob fixed; 17 chapters and 253 Level 1/2 requirements inventoried; no conformance claim.

checks.description: Secure-development evidence is mapped to NIST SSDF 1.1 without overstating conformance.
checks.detail: All four SSDF practice groups are mapped as partial/scoped alignment without a certification claim.

checks.description: Known serious/critical accessibility findings are explicit, bounded, and time-limited.
checks.detail: 0 known finding signatures are ratcheted; review due 2026-10-31.

checks.description: Every external GitHub Action is pinned to a full commit SHA.
The reference reverse proxy defines the browser security headers assessed by DAST.
checks.detail: Required reference-deployment headers: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy; request-body outer bound: 100 MB

checks.description: Every ZAP suppression is narrow, reasoned, and time-limited.
checks.detail: 7 explicit rule suppressions inspected; all require review by 2026-10-31.

checks.description: The application container runs unprivileged and does not publish its unauthenticated port.
checks.detail: Dockerfile must set USER perdura; the app service may expose port 8000 only to the proxy network.

checks.description: Build-only Python packaging tools are absent from the final application image.
checks.detail: The locked environment is installed with uv before pip, setuptools, and wheel are removed from the runtime layer.

checks.description: The k6 setup action receives an unprefixed semantic version.
checks.detail: Configured k6 version: 2.1.0; setup-k6-action supplies the release tag's v prefix.

checks.description: Unexpected API failures return a generic message and correlation identifier.
checks.detail: The exception is logged server-side while the response omits its internal text.

checks.description: Authored-report links use an explicit safe-protocol transformation.
checks.detail: The report renderer rejects executable/unsafe link targets; the ASVS tracker records this as partial URL evidence.

GitHub secret scanning, push protection, and Dependabot security-update settings

deployed TLS, authentication, authorization, throttling, and logging

interpretation: A pass establishes only the locally observable controls listed here. It is not a vulnerability-free, ASVS-conformant, or independently assessed claim.
